roadmap.title: Early island: first lands, skills and basic crafting
roadmap.description: Start on the Grass biome, buy the first lands, learn early skills and build the basic stations. Many counter feats (structures built, items crafted, enemies killed, coins) fill naturally from here on.

roadmap.title: Biome exploration, puzzles and NPC quests
roadmap.description: Buy lands in the Desert, Graveyard, Winter and Fire biomes. Solve the open-world puzzles, finish NPC quests and gather big chests.

roadmap.title: Dungeons and galaxy towers
roadmap.description: Clear the four dungeons (Ancient Tomb, Skull Maze, Crystal Cave, Fire Temple), find secret rooms and solve the four galaxy puzzles for seals.

roadmap.title: Museum, collections and all skills
roadmap.description: Fill the museum bundles, learn every skill and buy every land. Tool, accessory and other collections finish later, in stage 6.

roadmap.title: Sigil bosses and the Void
roadmap.description: Make sigils, defeat the late-game bosses and push the Void levels, which also supplies spirit orbs and resources.

roadmap.title: Late-game economy and nuclear structures
roadmap.description: Grind the huge coin totals, banks and nuclear structures, then pick up the remaining feats.

steps.text: Buy lands until you own 10, and keep 5,000 coins in your inventory.

achievements.summary: Mine the giant crystal in the Winter biome.

steps.text: Buy the Winter biome land, find the giant crystal, and mine it with a @item{Pickaxe}.

achievements.description: Gather royal steel or royal clothing
achievements.summary: Craft royal steel at a furnace or royal clothing at a sewing station.

steps.text: Learn the Craftsmanship skill.
Collect the gems the recipe needs, then craft @item{Royal Steel} at a furnace or @item{Royal Clothing} at a sewing station.

achievements.description: Have one of each gem in your inventory
achievements.summary: Hold one of every gem type in your inventory at the same time.

guide.context: Do not spend or sell the gems until the achievement unlocks.

steps.text: Break rocks and ores to collect @item{Emerald}, @item{Topaz}, @item{Ruby} and @item{Amethyst}.
Keep all of them in your inventory together.
Collect @item{Spirit Orb}s from chests, crafting and boss kills.
Use the orbs to add health until your max health is 10.

achievements.summary: Complete the Ancient Tomb dungeon in the Desert biome.

guide.context: If you get stuck, save and quit to leave the dungeon, then enter it again.

steps.text: Travel to the Desert biome and walk into the @loc{Ancient Tomb}.
Fight through it to the end, avoiding the @enemy{Electric Spikes}.

achievements.summary: Complete the Skull Maze dungeon in the Graveyard biome.

guide.context: If you get stuck, save and quit to leave the dungeon, then enter it again.

steps.text: Enter the @loc{Skull Maze} in the Graveyard biome.
Work through the maze to its goal. There is no boss.

achievements.summary: Complete the Crystal Cave dungeon in the Winter biome.

guide.context: If you get stuck, save and quit to leave the dungeon, then enter it again.

steps.text: Enter the @loc{Crystal Cave} in the Winter biome.
Fight through the cave and defeat the @enemy{Greater Ice Wizard}.

achievements.summary: Complete the Fire Temple dungeon in the Fire biome.

guide.context: If you get stuck, save and quit to leave the dungeon, then enter it again.

steps.text: Enter the @loc{Fire Temple} in the Fire biome.
Fight through the temple and defeat the @enemy{Great Demon}.

achievements.summary: Solve the Ancient Galaxy puzzle in the Constellation Tower in the Desert biome.

steps.text: Read the pattern carved above the windows outside the tower. Empty spaces mark the batteries to turn on.
Inside, use a @item{Pickaxe} to move the batteries into place.
Charge the marked batteries with a @item{Thunder Rod} shot or a Thunder Potion.

achievements.summary: Solve the Skull Galaxy puzzle in the Graveyard biome.

steps.text: Go to the Skull Galaxy in the Graveyard biome.
Enter the symbols by direction: Left is Water, Up is Key, Right is Paper, Down is Fish.

achievements.summary: Solve the Frozen Galaxy puzzle in the Winter biome.

steps.text: Go to the Frozen Galaxy in the Winter biome.
Set the computer screens, left to right, to show 5, 3, 4, 2 and 4 shapes.

achievements.summary: Solve the Fire Galaxy puzzle in the Fire biome.

steps.text: Go to the Fire Galaxy in the Fire biome.
Activate every lantern that is off, so all lanterns are on.
Activate every lantern that shows a number. All lanterns turn off and the puzzle is solved.

achievements.description: Complete a dungeon without taking damage
achievements.summary: Complete any one dungeon without taking damage.

guide.context: A dungeon resets when you leave, so you can retry it.

steps.text: Raise your health and damage with @item{Spirit Orb}s first.
Enter a dungeon and finish it without being hit once.

achievements.summary: Take the Challenge buff at a Dark Shrine and kill every monster it spawns.

guide.context: Rituals cost hearts, so raise your health with spirit orbs first.

steps.text: Travel to the Fire biome and find the @loc{Dark Shrine}.
Choose the "Challenge" buff.
Kill every monster that spawns.

achievements.description: Fail miserably at a trivia minigame
achievements.summary: Fail the trivia quiz run by Mr. Hopfrog in the Graveyard biome.

steps.text: Talk to @npc{Mr. Hopfrog} in the Graveyard biome and start the quiz.
Answer the questions. Whatever you pick counts as failing.

achievements.description: Kill an enemy with a single arrow shot
achievements.summary: Defeat one enemy using just one arrow.

steps.text: Learn the Hunting skill and craft a @item{Bow}.
Shoot a slime or a chicken. They have little health, so one arrow kills them.

achievements.description: Kill 3 enemies or more with a single sword slash
achievements.summary: Kill 3 or more enemies with a single sword swing.

steps.text: Learn the Combat skill, craft a @item{Sword} and upgrade it until it kills a slime in one hit.
Stand still so slimes jump toward you, then dodge around to bunch 3 or more together.
Swing once when they are all close.

achievements.description: Win the jackpot at a slot machine
achievements.summary: Win the jackpot on a slot machine.

steps.text: Learn the Gambling skill and build a @item{Slot Machine}.
Play it until three matching symbols line up.

achievements.summary: Kill a magic deer in the Winter biome.

steps.text: Find the magic deer in the Winter biome and kill it.

achievements.summary: Kill every giant beet in the Grass biome.

steps.text: Find all the giant beets in the Grass biome and kill each one.

achievements.summary: Win the ice wizard challenge in the Winter biome.

steps.text: Talk to the @npc{Ice Wizard} in the Winter biome to start the challenge.
Defeat every monster the challenge spawns, three or four in all.
Craft an empty @item{Bottle} at a forge.
Use the bottle on the rainbow found in the Grass biome.
Use the bottled rainbow on a building.
Learn the Manufacturing and Engineering skills.
Build a @item{Factory}.
Craft a droid and activate it. One droid is enough.

achievements.summary: Have 3 bombs active at the same time.

steps.text: Learn the Alchemy skill and build a @item{Cauldron}.
Craft 3 bombs.
Activate all 3 so they are lit at once.

guide.context: Archaeology items are rare. A @item{Liquid Luck} potion improves the odds.

steps.text: Build a shrine and take the "Excavator" buff.
Dig at digging spots with a @item{Shovel} until an archaeology item appears.
Learn the Calciverous skill.
Eat any gem from your inventory.
Die 10 times from any cause.
Keep playing until your play time passes 3 hours.
Build 20 structures. Building the same one again counts.
Buy lands until you own 5.
Kill 100 enemies. Slimes die fastest.

guide.context: A @item{Liquid Luck} potion gives more drops.

steps.text: Collect jelly until you hold 100 in your inventory at once.

guide.context: Keep the poop. The Fox quest needs 500.

steps.text: Collect poop from living animals and by digging. A @item{Liquid Luck} potion raises the chance.
At about 30, craft Animal Feed at a @item{Windmill} and feed it to a cowpig for more poop.
Learn the Fishing skill and build @item{Fish Trap}s.
Collect the catch from the traps until you have caught 50 fish.
Gather items until your inventory holds 1,000 at once.
Gather items until your inventory holds 5,000 at once.
Dig plots with a @item{Water Shovel} or better, or use sprinklers.
Plant seeds in watered ground until 100 seeds are watered.
Dig with a @item{Shovel} and plant seeds until you have planted 100.

guide.context: Keep items you need for quests and museum bundles.

steps.text: Sell items at the market until you hold 100,000 coins.

guide.context: Keep items you need for quests and museum bundles.

steps.text: Sell items at the market until you hold 1,000,000 coins.
Keep furnaces busy making iron and gold until you have crafted 500 furnace items.
Craft coins at a forge until you have made 2,000.

guide.context: Small chests do not count.

steps.text: Open the big chests from the four galaxy puzzles.
Open the big chests inside the dungeons.
Open the rest from open-world puzzles, NPC quests and museum bundles until you reach 20.
Dig with a @item{Shovel} until you have dug up 50 items.
Keep your crafting stations busy until you have crafted 10,000 items.
Build many cheap structures such as furnaces and anvils.
Take the builder buff at a shrine to halve building costs.

achievements.summary: Open a skull chest in the Graveyard biome.

steps.text: Find the skull chests guarded by spike traps in the Graveyard biome.
Pass the spikes with a @item{Bottled Fairy}, or destroy them with a bomb, Thunder Rod or fire arrow.
Open a skull chest.

achievements.description: Build on top of every water tile
achievements.summary: Build a bridge or landfill on every water tile.

guide.context: This feat is unreliable. It may not unlock even when every tile is covered.

steps.text: Cover every water tile with a bridge or landfill. Landfill alone fits the left edge.
Make your last placement a landfill.

If the achievement stays locked, close the game and open secretSettings.ini in your Forager save folder. Change theSeeker from "0" to "1". Reload, then break and replace one landfill. An arrow points to any missed tile.
Replace any bridge the arrow points to with landfill.

achievements.summary: Find 3 secret rooms in the dungeons.

guide.context: The Ancient Tomb has 3 secret rooms, so one dungeon is enough.

steps.text: Bring a bomb, a higher-level pickaxe or the @item{Fire Rod}.
In a dungeon, look for an isolated cracked piece of wall at the edge and break it open.

achievements.summary: Find all 14 secret rooms across the four dungeons and the Wizard Tower.

guide.context: Use a bomb, a higher-level pickaxe or the Fire Rod on an isolated cracked piece of wall at the edge of a dungeon.

steps.text: Ancient Tomb: find 3 secret rooms.
Fire Temple: find 4 secret rooms.
Skull Maze: find 3 secret rooms.
Crystal Cave: find 3 secret rooms.
Wizard Tower in the Fire biome: find 1 secret room.
Shoot 100 arrows with a @item{Bow}.
Learn @mechanic{Textiles}, then craft @item{Boots} at the @mechanic{Sewing Station}.
Learn the @mechanic{Evasion} skill for 15% more dodge chance.
Fight enemies until 10 attacks miss you.

achievements.summary: Dodge an attack that would have killed you.

guide.context: You need a hit that would kill you at your current health, so lower your health first.

steps.text: Craft upgraded @item{Boots}. Learn Alchemy and brew one @item{Dragon Philtre} at the @mechanic{Cauldron}.
Place a @item{Spike Trap} and step on it until you are at or near 2 hearts.
Drink the @item{Dragon Philtre}, then step on the trap again. A dodge unlocks the achievement.
If the spike hits, you die. Return and repeat the steps.
steps.note: A bomb blast works the same way as the trap.

steps.text: Go to the @loc{Graveyard} biome and break gravestones with a @item{Pickaxe} until you reach 100.
Craft @item{Bottles} at the @mechanic{Forge}.
Click critters with a @item{Bottle} until you have bottled 100.

achievements.summary: Talk to every NPC in the game.

steps.text: Buy every land, then speak to each NPC you find on every island.
Finish the nine Helper quests. They belong to the @npc{Fox}, @npc{Old Man}, @npc{Ghost}, @npc{Engineer}, @npc{Fairy Queen}, @npc{Goblin}, @npc{Wizard}, @npc{Princess} and @npc{Druid}.
Also finish the @npc{Jester} and @npc{Wizrob} quests.

achievements.summary: Give the Druid 2 Bottled Torchbug, 30 Tree Sapling and 1 Dino Egg.

steps.text: Get 2 @item{Bottled Torchbug}, 30 @item{Tree Sapling} and 1 @item{Dino Egg}.
Take them to the @npc{Druid} in the @loc{Grass} biome.
steps.note: The Dino Egg comes from digging in the @loc{Fire} biome.

achievements.summary: Give Princess Anna 40 Flower and 2 Royal Clothing.

steps.text: Learn @mechanic{Craftsmanship}, then craft 2 @item{Royal Clothing} at the @mechanic{Sewing Station}.
Gather 40 @item{Flower}.
Take them to @npc{Princess Anna} in the @loc{Desert} biome.

achievements.summary: Give the Wizard 20 Cinderbloom, 5 Star Fragments, 10 Void Steel and 10 Royal Steel.

steps.text: Learn @mechanic{Transmutation} to unlock @item{Void Steel}, and @mechanic{Craftsmanship} for @item{Royal Steel}.
Gather 20 @item{Cinderbloom}, 5 @item{Star Fragment}, 10 @item{Void Steel} and 10 @item{Royal Steel}.
Take them to the @npc{Wizard} in the @loc{Fire} biome.
Gather 100 @item{Bone}.
Take it to the @npc{Goblin} in the @loc{Graveyard} biome.

achievements.summary: Give the Fairy Queen 1,000 coins (10,000 on Hard).

steps.text: Go to the @npc{Fairy Queen} in the @loc{Grass} biome at night.
Pay 1,000 coins, or 10,000 coins on Hard.
Learn @mechanic{Craftsmanship} and make 10 @item{Royal Steel}.
Take it to the @npc{Engineer} in the @loc{Fire} biome.

achievements.summary: Give the Ghost 2 Demon Horn and 1 Kapala.

steps.text: Get 2 @item{Demon Horn} and 1 @item{Kapala}.
Take them to the @npc{Ghost} in the @loc{Winter} biome at night.
steps.note: The Kapala comes from digging in the @loc{Graveyard} biome.

achievements.summary: Give the Old Man 1 Golden Egg.

steps.text: Interact with chickens until one drops a @item{Golden Egg}.
Take it to the @npc{Old Man} in the @loc{Desert} biome.
steps.note: @item{Liquid Luck} raises the chance. Droids can also tend the chickens for you.

steps.text: Collect @item{Poop} from living animals, or by digging in biomes.
At about 30 @item{Poop}, make Animal Feed at a @mechanic{Windmill} and feed a cowpig to get more.
Repeat until you hold 500, then take it to the @npc{Fox} in the @loc{Winter} biome.
@item{Liquid Luck} raises the chance of Poop.

steps.text: Finish the Foraging, Mining, Building, Farming, Cooking, Alchemy, Trapping and Archaeology bundles.
Talk to the museum curator once more after the last bundle.
Spend skill points until every skill tile is bought.
Buy a skill next to a locked skill to unlock it.
steps.note: The last skills need level 65, the maximum.

steps.text: Keep buying lands from the map until none are left.
The full cost is about 507,780 coins without discounts.

guide.context: Small chests do not count. Using the Obliterator on certain puzzle parts can remove their chests for good, so open every chest before you use it.

achievements.summary: Earn every other achievement in the game.

steps.text: Finish all the other achievements. Waterproof is one of them.
Open the achievements list in the game to see which ones are left.
Learn @mechanic{Summoning}, then craft a small @item{Void Portal} at the @mechanic{Sigil Maker}, or buy one from the @npc{Wandering Trader}.
Enter the Void and clear levels until you reach level 5.
Enter the @item{Void Portal} and clear levels until you reach level 10.
Enter the @item{Void Portal} and clear levels until you reach level 20.
Perform rituals at the @loc{Fire} biome @mechanic{Dark Shrine} and choose @mechanic{Wrath} for +1 damage.
steps.note: Each Spirit Orb adds only 0.25 damage, so rituals are worth more. Farm orbs, turn them into life, and spend the life on rituals.

guide.context: Droids kill most enemies for you, so build up droids and damage before you enter.

steps.text: Farm the @enemy{Slime King} with Slime Sigils. Each boss drops 4 @item{Spirit Orb} from a chest that lighthouses do not boost.
At the @mechanic{Dark Shrine}, do rituals for @mechanic{Termination}, then @mechanic{Wrath}, then @mechanic{Hermetics}. Spend hearts down to one heart.
steps.note: Keep 4 to 7 hearts if you run low on orbs. Bottled fairies stop you dying.

steps.text: Repeat until you have about 40 droids.
Spend orbs on @item{Attack Orb} or @item{Ultra Attack Orb} until a sword swing does about 500 damage.
steps.note: Do not go much higher. Too much damage makes your attacks heal enemies.

steps.text: Drink @item{Bloodfury Cocktail}, @item{Dragon Philtre} and @item{Thunderstrike} after a Dexterous buff, and bring 10 to 15 @item{Atomic Bomb}.
Enter the Void and reach level 30. From level 20, fight the bosses yourself and drop one @item{Atomic Bomb} when each level begins.
steps.note: Your best weapon is the @item{Cosmic Bow}. The Ballistics skill makes it fire three arrows.

achievements.description: Light all torches in the Skull Maze
achievements.summary: Light every torch in the Skull Maze.

steps.text: Go to the @loc{Skull Maze} in the @loc{Graveyard} biome and light each torch.
Learn @mechanic{Transmutation} to unlock @item{Void Steel}.
Craft any Void gear, such as the @item{Void Pickaxe}: 10 @item{Void Steel} and 5 @item{Bottled Deathmoth} at the @mechanic{Forge}.
Learn @mechanic{Astrology} to unlock @item{Cosmic Steel}.
Craft any Cosmic gear, such as the @item{Cosmic Pickaxe}: 10 @item{Cosmic Steel} and 5 @item{Bottled Deathmoth} at the @mechanic{Forge}.
Learn @mechanic{Summoning} to unlock the @mechanic{Sigil Maker}.
Craft a sigil there, or buy one from the @npc{Wandering Trader}.

guide.context: The first Slime Sigil needs about 500 slimes and electronics. The Slime King is the easiest boss.

steps.text: Get a sigil from the @mechanic{Sigil Maker} or the @npc{Wandering Trader}, and use it to summon the @enemy{Slime King}.
Defeat the @enemy{Slime King}.
Get a sigil from the @mechanic{Sigil Maker} or the @npc{Wandering Trader}, and use it to summon the @enemy{Skeleton King}.
Defeat the @enemy{Skeleton King}.
Get a sigil from the @mechanic{Sigil Maker} or the @npc{Wandering Trader}, and use it to summon the @enemy{Dark Beet}.
Defeat the @enemy{Dark Beet}.

guide.context: Do this while you work on Billionaire and Trillionaire.

steps.text: Take a builder buff from a shrine, then place 30 or more @item{Bank} structures close together.
Cover them with @item{Power Plant} structures. The @mechanic{Physics} skill unlocks power plants.
Leave the game running. It takes about 1 to 3 hours, and more banks finish faster.

achievements.summary: Upgrade every rod to its top version.

steps.text: Find the four dungeon rods: Thunder Rod in @loc{Ancient Tomb}, Fire Rod in @loc{Fire Temple}, Ice Rod in @loc{Crystal Cave}, Necro Rod in @loc{Skull Maze}.
Learn @mechanic{Spirituality} to unlock the @mechanic{Spirit Forge}.
Upgrade each rod at the @mechanic{Spirit Forge}. Each upgrade needs 10 @item{Star Fragment} plus 10 of each item below.
steps.note: Meteor Rod: Lava Eel, Fossil. Blizzard Rod: Frozen Relic, Frozen Squid. Storm Rod: Anchor, Sunken Ankh. Death Rod: Skeleton Fish, Sphynx.

achievements.summary: Hold 1,000,000,000 coins at the same time.

guide.context: A fully upgraded wallet and amulet and a Dexterous buff speed this up. More lighthouses finish faster.

steps.text: Place 9 @item{Spike Trap} in a 3 by 3 area.
Craft the @item{Obliterator} at the @mechanic{Factory} after learning Manufacturing. It costs 20 @item{Cosmic Steel} and 20 @item{Fiberglass}.
Use the @item{Obliterator} to clear space around it, take a builder buff, and build 15 or more @item{Lighthouse}.
steps.note: Open every big chest before you use the Obliterator.

steps.text: Upgrade the @item{Necro Rod} into the @item{Death Rod} at the @mechanic{Spirit Forge}, which needs the Spirituality skill.
Fire the @item{Death Rod} onto the spikes to make skeletons that drop coins, bones and skulls.
After about 500 million bones and skulls, take the Merchant buff and sell them all. Repeat until you hold 1,000,000,000 coins.

achievements.summary: Hold 1,000,000,000,000 coins at the same time.

steps.text: Use the same spike, lighthouse and @item{Death Rod} setup as for Billionaire.
Sell bones and skulls under the Merchant buff, and repeat until you hold 1,000,000,000,000 coins.
Get a sigil from the @mechanic{Sigil Maker} or the @npc{Wandering Trader}, and use it to summon the @enemy{Toxic Guardian}.
Defeat the @enemy{Toxic Guardian}.
Learn @mechanic{Physics}, then upgrade your @mechanic{Factory} to nuclear to make @item{Nuclear Machinery}.
Craft any Nuclear item, such as the @item{Nuclear Pickaxe}: 10 @item{Nuclear Machinery} and 50 @item{Uranium} at the @mechanic{Forge}.

achievements.description: Upgrade a structure to use nuclear power
achievements.summary: Upgrade a structure to use nuclear power.

steps.text: Learn @mechanic{Physics}.
Upgrade a @mechanic{Factory} to nuclear.
Upgrade your @mechanic{Factory} to nuclear, then craft 50 @item{Nuclear Machinery}. A nuclear structure crafts two items for the cost of one, so you end up with 100.
Take a builder buff, then place about 90 cheap structures such as furnaces, forges or sewing stations.
Upgrade them all to nuclear. Upgrade only a few factories, because nuclear fuel is costly.
steps.note: You can destroy the structures after the achievement unlocks.
